name: Pinterest + Etsy Demand Sensing
one_liner: Treat Pinterest, Etsy, TikTok, Shopify and marketplaces as revealed-demand sensors feeding grounded campaign graphs.
core_thesis: Idea generation improves when the model begins from typed observations of what people aspire to, buy, list and accelerate around. Cross-platform lead/lag signals can generate candidate products and campaigns that are then filtered by economics rather than invented from prompts alone.
why_now: Public/platform data plus inexpensive LLM normalization can turn fragmented trend surfaces into reusable evidence.
job: Find grounded product/business opportunities and produce structured hypotheses with falsifiers.
distribution: Internal signal service first; Feedify/API/MCP/x402 later.
moat: Historical normalized signal graph, cross-platform lead/lag calibration and campaign outcome feedback.
falsifiers: Signals are too noisy or delayed to beat simple trend browsing.
Platform access is unstable enough to destroy continuity.
Observed trends fail to predict monetizable demand.

success_definition: All 12 checkpoints PROVEN on live evidence, with no unresolved critical H-task or security gate.

repo_binding.polling: GitHub snapshots are implementation evidence only; checkpoint proof comes from validator receipts.

software_substitution_test.counterfactual: OpenAI/platform vendors ship perfect software for every reproducible feature in this project tomorrow.
surviving_value: proprietary mapping from signals to downstream commercial outcomes
software_substitution_test.rationale: Public information transforms are easy to synthesize. The valuable layer is calibrated signal→decision→outcome history unavailable to outsiders.

underengineer.rule: Choose the earliest real-world event that increases controlled scarce state; build only its prerequisites plus safety and verification.
underengineer.minimal_live_product: Track one source family for one product decision, make one explicit prediction/action, then attach the real listing/campaign outcome. No broad dashboard.

steps.action: Capture one timestamped signal with provenance
Record one falsifiable commercial decision derived from it
steps.acceptance: Decision and baseline are frozen before outcome.
Outcome is verified and time-ordered after decision.

underengineer.graduation_rule: Enough linked outcomes exist to show one signal family improves decisions against baseline.
underengineer.kill_or_rethink_rule: If public signals do not add predictive value once real outcomes are linked, stop scaling ingestion.
underengineer.project_manager_invariant: A feature may enter NOW only if it is necessary to reach the first real moat event, required for safety/verification, or empirically unblocks that path.
underengineer.observation_pause: After the first live moat event, stop expanding and inspect customer/outcome evidence before choosing the next feature.

full_roadmap_policy: The original checkpoint ladder is a capability library, not default build order. UNDERENGINEER chooses the live minimum path.

experiment_strategy.learning_goal: Link a demand signal to a frozen action and real outcome.
